review_scope: Existing experiment matrix and evidence available on the reviewed mainline; no new sources, acquisitions, external services, or production promotions.

review.hosted_ci_consumption: Existing required GitHub Actions lanes; exact metered credits are unavailable in this repository evidence.
review.supply_chain: No dependency added. Preview projections remain optional/rebuildable; no production dependency adopted.
review.security_and_operations: Keep inputs untrusted; reject ambiguous JSON and invalid RDF identifiers; generated catalogues, graphs, and indexes are disposable derivatives. Use Python 3.14 and portable Gold tables as the fallback. Rebuild derivatives from their inputs after corruption; delete them for rollback or withdrawal.
review.rights_boundary: No licensing conclusion. Current synthetic fixtures do not contain restricted terminology. The graph export contract does not inspect restricted content embedded inside allowed fields_json values; content-level restricted-byte screening and rights authority remain open gates.

dispositions.basis: The exact existing public object and anonymous digest are pinned and verified. Comparative request/byte amplification, latency, memory, and result-parity measurements remain absent, so this experiment remains deferred.
dispositions.fallback: Pinned anonymous object download and bounded local DuckDB query.

dispositions.basis: Two exact public historical revisions and anonymous byte verification remain absent.
dispositions.fallback: Restore full pinned objects and independently verify each SHA-256.

dispositions.basis: Existing public Parquet to Iceberg content parity and hosted registration are verified; this is rebuildable metadata only and does not satisfy raw-source parity or grant production authority.

Exact existing MBS/PBS revisions are bound into metadata-only cross-dataset package leaves and verified by the package verifier. The artifact remains a preview because payload bytes were not fetched/rehashed for content parity; this does not qualify rights or source coverage.
dispositions.fallback: Verify each object from its independent SHA-256 receipt.

dispositions.basis: Deterministic reference, Cypher, RDF-star, and NetworkX graph projections are bounded to existing portable Gold/synthetic fixtures; RDF identifier encoding and duplicate-key rejection are verified. Semantic calibration, live Neo4j/SPARQL parity, public graph qualification, and restricted-content screening remain open.
dispositions.fallback: Query portable Gold node and edge tables directly; keep candidate retrieval non-authoritative.

dispositions.basis: On six existing synthetic cases, identifier-first lexical recall@5 is 0.25, both negative controls produced candidates, and abstention is 0.5. Confidence calibration was not evaluated. Ontology and embedding fixtures are unavailable; Tantivy and Qdrant lack a measured requirement.
dispositions.fallback: Keep candidate retrieval non-authoritative and require human review; use exact identifiers and portable table queries.

dispositions.basis: No measured multi-writer or high-update requirement justifies another transactional engine.
dispositions.fallback: Immutable Parquet, append-only receipts, and embedded DuckDB.

decision: No preview feature is promoted. Reopen deferred rows only when their stated prerequisites are met; any production promotion requires a separate ADR and implementation track.
